mechanics.claim: The zone deals damage on cast, then again when it erupts after persisting, for two separate damage instances that can both hit.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemy champions within at the time of cast. The zone then persists for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and {{tip|silence|silences}} enemies within.

mechanics.claim: The eruption deals the same damage a second time and roots enemies hit.
mechanics.quote: Afterwards, the zone erupts to deal the same damage to enemy champions within and {{tip|root}} them for a duration.

mechanics.claim: Equinox's silence is non-dispellable and is not blocked by spell shield, though the damage/root portions can still be blocked.
mechanics.quote: ''Equinox's'' {{tip|silence}} is marked as non-dispellable, so it is not removed by most {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}}.
